system.description:
Your Lifebinding Spirit takes the form of a perfect illusory double of yourself and is considered an illusion. You can cast spells as if you were in the spirit's place, though you use your senses. When a creature would see through your double, it only means they can clearly tell the difference between you and it.

Illusory Double. Your Lifebinding Spirit is still Ethereal and immune to harm. It follows all normal illusion rules and has every sensory element that you normally would. When a target that can see through your double looses sight of both you and a spirit of yours or you swap places with a spirit, it can no longer tell the difference.
